text:
SERVANT:
  It is, my lord.
HOTSPUR:
  That roan will be my throne.
  Right, I'll ride him straight away. O Esperance!
  Tell Butler to lead him out into the park.
  (The Servant leaves.)
LADY PERCY:
  But listen to me, my lord.
HOTSPUR:
  What is it, my lady?
LADY PERCY:
  What is it that's carrying you away?
HOTSPUR:
  Why, my horse, my love. My horse.
LADY PERCY:
  Oh, stop it, you mad-headed ape!
  A weasel doesn't have half the temper that's throwing you around.
  I swear, I'll find out what you're up to, Harry. I will.
  I'm afraid my brother Mortimer is making a move to claim his title,
  and he's sent for you to back him up.
  But if you go—
